release.title: What's New in Viku
release.subtitle: Your tasks now reach your home screen, and finding what matters takes one tap.

hero.title: Calendar widget
hero.body: See your week and overdue tasks without opening the app. Available in small, medium, and large sizes.

features.title: Saved filters
features.body: Combine priority, labels, and dates, and save it alongside your projects.

features.title: App icon badge
features.body: Viku's icon shows how many tasks you have due today or overdue.

features.title: Task dependencies
features.body: Mark which task blocks another. Viku lets you know when you can start.

fixes: Sync is now up to 2x faster on instances with many projects.
Reminders no longer duplicate when changing time zones.
Better dark mode contrast for colored labels.

add-calendar-widget.title: Add the widget
add-calendar-widget.intro: Takes less than a minute. You can add several in different sizes.

steps.title: Touch and hold the Home Screen
steps.body: Touch and hold an empty area until the icons start jiggling.

steps.title: Search for Viku and pick a size
steps.body: Swipe to see small, medium, and large. Tap Add Widget.

add-calendar-widget.tip: Touch and hold the widget and choose Edit Widget to show just one project or filter.
